_comment: Pages that exist in the repo but are deliberately kept off every generated surface: no card in the filterable index on activities.html, no entry in data/exercises.json, no sitemap URL, no JSON-LD ItemList entry. The file stays so the work is not lost and can be finished later. Read by scripts/build-exercise-data.js (which drops them from the registry) and scripts/inventory.js (which marks them `withheld`, so scripts/check-activities.js does not report them as orphans and instead checks the inverse — that no hub still links them).
uni-al-munir-relationships.html: Withheld 2026-08-30. Its SHEET_URL was never replaced with a real Apps Script /exec URL, so every submission failed and the student's work was lost; its Listening Task also points at PASTE_AUDIO_URL_HERE.mp3 with no transcript anywhere in the page to generate audio from. The endpoint is a one-line fix (the other uni-* pages use a working URL), but the listening step needs a conversation script written, so the page is held back rather than shipped broken or deleted.
